title: Migration: subcard identity + supersede state, drop card_rev + drawing text cols
description:
Consolidated schema migration covering ADR-0003 (subcard identity), ADR-0004 (Pi web kiosk), ADR-0005 (as-issued vs as-built doc), and 3wk walkthrough decisions (2026-05-17).

== production_card_part ==
ADD primary_drawing_doc_id uuid FK -> document_incoming_scan(id), nullable. App enforces non-null at card issue.
DROP drawing_number text
DROP drawing_rev text
INDEX on primary_drawing_doc_id

== production_card ==
RENAME doc_id -> issued_doc_id (the as-planned doc at issue)
ADD closed_doc_id uuid FK -> document_incoming_scan(id), nullable (the as-built doc at close, per ADR-0005)
DROP card_rev (vestigial; replacement = new card via supersede chain)
EXTEND state CHECK to include 'superseded'
ADD required_final_inspections text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
ADD ndt_coverage_percent smallint NULL CHECK (ndt_coverage_percent IS NULL OR ndt_coverage_percent BETWEEN 1 AND 100)
SoD CHECK: keep R1 (issued_by <> closed_by), add R3 (issued_by <> qc_signed_by). R2 + R4 are app-layer cross-table checks (no DB constraint feasible).

== production_card_inspection ==
ADD inspection_type text NULL (nullable for hold-point rows; required for card-level final rows; values reference production_inspection_type.code)

== production_card_signoff ==
EXTEND type CHECK to include 'request_changes'. Final CHECK: ('issue','hold','close','release','cancel','request_changes')

== production_inspection_type (NEW register table) ==
code text PK
label text NOT NULL
category text
description text
created_at, updated_at
Seed with 6 codes:
  ('geometric', 'Geometric / dimensional', 'dimensional', '...')
  ('weld_visual', 'Visual weld inspection', 'weld', '...')
  ('weld_mpi', 'Magnetic particle inspection', 'weld', '...')
  ('weld_dpi', 'Dye penetrant inspection', 'weld', '...')
  ('cosmetic', 'Cosmetic / surface finish', 'finish', '...')
  ('client_specific', 'Client-specific requirement', 'client', '...')

== App layer ==
At issue:
  - 'geometric' auto-added to required_final_inspections (always)
  - 'weld_visual' auto-added when exc_class >= 2 AND card has weld op (locked in UI)
  - NDT dropdown (None | MPI | DPI), default None at EXC 2; if MPI/DPI selected, ndt_coverage_percent required
  - Cosmetic/client_specific are optional checkboxes
Part detail page + parts editor: read drawing identity from FK + doc-service title-block; set primary_drawing_doc_id from drawing picker.
Issue flow: submitted_for_qc -> request_changes -> draft transition supported.
Final inspection: card -> 'complete' when every code in required_final_inspections has a passing row.
Close flow: 2-actor (closer ≠ any final-inspector via R4 app-check); at state -> closed, regenerate as-built PDF, file to doc-service (NEW doc_number), populate closed_doc_id.

RLS unchanged.

Blocks: b5t (needs FK + supersede + request_changes + issued_doc_id/closed_doc_id columns). Blocks: qvp (kiosk subcard QR resolution + inspection_type for inspector flow). Blocks: 3wk (lightweight inspections + final + close).
close_reason: Migration 009 applied to Supabase 2026-05-17 — covers all locked schema changes from b5t + 3wk walkthroughs and ADR-0003 / ADR-0005.

title: Supabase migrations: production_card data model
description:
Create migrations under app/migrations/ for the data model defined in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (Data model section). Tables:
- production_cards (state machine, dual-signoff columns, doc_id, doc_number, card_rev, exc_class denorm, supersedes self-FK)
- card_parts (drawing meta, material_spec, FKs to purchase_orders + document_matl_cert nullable)
- card_part_ops (seq, op_code FK, required_skill, hold_point_after, wps_id nullable, state)
- production_card_events (kiosk_id, employee_id, card_part_op_id, action enum, consumable_heat nullable, meta jsonb, ts)
- card_op_sessions (view derived from events: pair start+stop, duration)
- card_inspections (level_iso5817, defects jsonb, photo_ids jsonb, signer)
- card_signoffs (role, type, employee_id, signed_at, notes)
- op_library (code PK, label, required_skill, default_hold_point_after, category)
- routing_templates + routing_template_ops (process_family, seq → op_code)
- wps (full attributes from Welding Control Register sheet 3)
- welder_qualifications (welder_employee_id FK, wps_id_or_range, expires_at, status, qualification_doc_id)

Also: ALTER employees ADD COLUMN skill_set text[], auth_user_id uuid REFERENCES auth_users(id). ALTER project_register ADD COLUMN exc_class smallint (if not already present).

RLS policies for each table: authenticated read; role-gated writes per the role matrix in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
notes:
Table names per docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (updated 2026-05-11 after naming review): production_card / production_card_part / production_card_part_op / production_card_event / production_card_op_session (view) / production_card_inspection / production_card_signoff / welding_wps / welding_welder_qualification / production_op_library / production_routing_template / production_routing_template_op. Earlier draft used unprefixed names (wps, op_library, etc.) — do NOT use those.
Update 2026-05-11: (1) employees gets 'role text[]' (NOT skill_set). (2) project_register_items gets 'exc_class smallint' (NOT project_register). (3) production_card_part gets 'exc_class smallint' (denormed at issue). (4) production_card has NO exc_class column. Card-level UIs derive max exc_class via JOIN to parts.
Schema update 2026-05-11: production_card identity is FK-only — doc_id (→document_incoming_scan.id) and project_register_item_id (→project_register_items.id). Do NOT add doc_number or project_number text columns on production_card; resolve via JOIN. exc_class is on production_card (single column denormed from project_register_items at issue). production_card_part has neither exc_class nor project_register_item_id (both inherited from card). One card = one project_register_items row.
close_reason: Six migrations under migration/ covering full data model from docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: 001 column adds on employees + project_register_items; 002 welding_wps + welding_welder_qualification; 003 production_op_library + production_routing_template + production_routing_template_op; 004 production_card + production_card_part + production_card_part_op; 005 production_card_event (append-only) + production_card_op_session view; 006 production_card_inspection + production_card_signoff. State enums via text + CHECK. RLS authenticated read; writes mostly authenticated; production_card_event writes are service-role-only (kiosk HMAC route). updated_at via shared set_updated_at() function. README explains run order + assumptions.

title: Web: lightweight inspections + final inspection + close flow
description:
Inspector + QC facing flows for EXC <= 2 cards (MVP scope). EXC >= 3 structured inspection deferred to bd-wes (P3). Locked design per 3wk walkthrough 2026-05-17.

OP-LEVEL INSPECTIONS (at hold-points)
1. Kiosk-only for MVP. Inspector taps RFID + scans subcard QR + picks an op in awaiting_inspection state. Smart-device web flow is a P3 follow-on (see filed bd issue).
2. UI: pass / fail / rework + free-text note + signer (auth_users) + submitted_at. inspection_type stays NULL for hold-point rows.
3. Pass -> op state to 'accepted'. Fail/rework -> op state to 'pending' (operator re-scans + redoes). Failure history queryable via multiple production_card_inspection rows on same card_part_op_id; explicit supersedes_inspection_id FK can be added later if analytics demand.
4. SoD R2 (app-layer): inspector_employee_id <> any employee_id with a session on that op.

FINAL INSPECTION (card-level)
1. Card auto-transitions to 'awaiting_final_inspection' when all op-level work is accepted.
2. required_final_inspections (text[]) on card sets the required types. Each required type produces one production_card_inspection row (card_id set, card_part_op_id NULL, inspection_type=code).
3. Card auto-transitions to 'complete' when every required type has a passing row.
4. Inspectors pick a type from the card's required list at the kiosk; one row signs one type.

CLOSE (2-actor model)
1. Card is in 'complete' state with all final inspection rows passing.
2. QC reviews paperwork + presence of all required signoffs + linked material certs. Clicks close.
3. SoD R4 (app-layer): closed_by <> any inspector_employee_id on the card's final inspection rows.
4. System regenerates the as-built PDF (full traveller with all signoffs, session timestamps, inspection results, linked material/WPS references) and files to doc-service via POST /api/file with the same iso_description_id as issue (66 shop / 67 site). doc-service mints a new doc_number; production_card.closed_doc_id is set.
5. production_card_signoff row inserted (role='qc', type='close', employee_id=closed_by, notes optional).
6. State -> 'closed' (immutable).

NDT HANDLING AT FINAL
- If required_final_inspections contains weld_mpi or weld_dpi, ndt_coverage_percent is the spec. Inspector confirms in notes that coverage met the spec; system stores spec for reference but doesn't compute compliance.

Acceptance: an EXC <= 2 card moves draft -> submitted_for_qc -> issued -> in_progress -> awaiting_final_inspection -> complete -> closed with all signoffs and inspections recorded, AND both issued_doc_id and closed_doc_id populated in doc-service.

title: Auto-close production-card sessions on shift-end clock-out
description:
Reactive trigger: when an employee's tap in timecard_events flips them to 'out' status (parity rule), close any open production_card_events session for that employee_id.

Implementation: Supabase trigger or scheduled function (whichever fits the existing patterns in pss-employee-presence). Insert a synthetic production_card_events row with action='stop' and meta={reason:'auto_shift_end'}.

Edge cases:
- Employee clocks out then back in same day → existing session stays closed; new scan starts a new session
- Employee taps but pre-flight fails (welder qual expired) → no session opened, nothing to close
- Multiple cards open (shouldn't happen per Q7(a), but defensively): close all

Acceptance: an open weld session at 5pm gets a stop event when the employee clocks out at 5:30pm; the card_op_sessions view shows the closed session with the correct duration.

title: Kiosk web app (Pi + 7" touchscreen): subcard scan + weld pre-flight + serial picker
description:
Kiosk runs as a web app on Pi + 7" touchscreen per ADR-0004 — NOT firmware on M5Stack.

Hardware: Raspberry Pi 4 (4GB+), 7" capacitive touchscreen, USB barcode scanner, USB 125kHz/13.56MHz RFID reader (HID profile), wall-mount enclosure. No firmware/PlatformIO.

Software: a /kiosk route in the same Next.js app as the planner UI. Locked to Chromium --kiosk fullscreen on Pi boot. Same Docker pipeline.

Flow:
1. Idle screen — waits for RFID tap. USB RFID reader sends card_id as keystrokes into a focused input.
2. POST /api/kiosk/resolve-operator with {card_id} -> returns {employee_id, name, role[]}.
3. 'Hi {name}' + 'Scan a subcard QR'.
4. Barcode scanner sends QR payload as keystrokes. Payload format: {card.doc_number}/{primary_drawing.doc_number}.
5. POST /api/kiosk/scan {employee_id, qr_payload, kiosk_id, hmac}.
6. Backend:
   a. Parse qr_payload -> look up Card + Subcard.
   b. Filter ops on the Subcard by operator.role. Present eligible ops for 1-tap pick (or auto-start if exactly one).
   c. WELD PRE-FLIGHT for op_code='weld': check welder qual current for op.wps_id (fail closed if not qualified or expired). Prompt for consumable heat scan/entry. Validate against WPS consumable_spec.
   d. Auto-close any prior open session for this employee.
   e. Insert production_card_event(action='start') via a single recordKioskEvent(...) helper (forward-compat per ADR-0002 — later writes pass_id when Seam/Pass land).
7. Session running screen — shows op + Subcard + elapsed time + 'Tap to stop'.
8. At session-stop (RFID tap, shift-end auto-close, or scan-in elsewhere):
   - SERIAL PICKER: touch grid of paint-pen serials (001..qty). Operator taps completed serials.
   - For weld ops: capture per-piece heat. Default = session-start heat; '+ Add heat change' lets welder declare a new heat for subsequent serial taps.
   - Persist as {pieces_completed: [{serial, heat?}, ...]} in production_card_event.meta on the stop event.

HMAC: shared secret from KIOSK_HMAC_SECRET env, SHA256 of (timestamp + body). Reject events older than 5 minutes.

Out of scope: industrial-grade IP-rated displays (P3 refinement); offline mode (P3+).

Depends on the migration issue (primary_drawing_doc_id FK + supersede state + drop card_rev/drawing text columns).
notes:
Naming correction 2026-05-11: 'skill_set' is now 'role' on employees. Op-library column is 'required_role'.

Forward-compat note 2026-05-16 (Seam/Pass): kiosk event writes must go through a single helper function — e.g. recordKioskEvent(...) — so a later session-to-pass retrofit per ADR-0002 is one call-site change.

Platform pivot 2026-05-16: this issue rewritten from M5Stack firmware to Pi + 7" touchscreen web kiosk per ADR-0004. The firmware/ directory plan is dropped. See docs/adr/0004-kiosk-pi-web-app.md.

Welding extraction 2026-05-17 (ADR-0006): WPS + welder qualification CRUD moved to pss-welding-control. The kiosk weld preflight here READS welding_wps + welding_welder_qualification via cross-app DB access (same Supabase, RLS-restricted). No code change for production-card kiosk queries; only ownership semantics changed. zr5 was closed as moved.

title: Web: dual e-signoff issue flow → mint 61355 + file traveller PDF
description:
Issue button on draft cards. Flow:
1. Planner clicks 'Submit for QC review' → state stays draft but locks routing
2. QC reviews + clicks 'Issue' → both signatures captured into card_signoffs (role=planner type=issue + role=qc type=issue)
3. On dual signoff: state → issued. Card immutable from this point except for the rev mechanism.
4. App POSTs traveller PDF to pss-document-service /api/file with iso_description_id=66 (shop) or 67 (site), project_number=card.project_number. Stores returned id + doc_number on the card row.
5. PDF generation: cover sheet with QR + header (project, customer, exc_class, dates), part pages each with QR + drawing meta + routing ops + signoff blocks. Library: @react-pdf/renderer or playwright→PDF. Decide at impl time.
6. Re-issue path (card_rev > 1): refile via doc-service refile_override endpoint with -r2 suffix.

Acceptance: a draft card with 2 parts can be dual-signed, gets a doc_number like '10358-M&DC-0001', and the PDF is retrievable via the doc service URL.
notes: PDF generation approach (locked 2026-05-17): use @react-pdf/renderer in app/lib/pdf/ — full traveller cover + per-subcard pages + routing + signoff blocks + QR. Isolate behind a single function generateTravellerPdf(cardData) -> bytes so the future migration to pss-pdf-render (see followup bd issue) is one call-site change. POST resulting bytes to pss-document-service via existing /api/file contract (iso_description_id=66 shop, 67 site). No synthetic-cover shortcut — shop floor needs the full paper traveller per ARCHITECTURE.md:11.

title: Web: project picker → card draft → parts → routing editor
description:
Planner-facing flow. Screens:
1. /production-card — landing: list of cards, filterable by state + project + exc_class
2. /production-card/new — project picker (autocomplete project_register), variant pick (shop|site), creates draft card
3. /production-card/[id] — draft view: add parts (drawing_no, rev, qty, description, weight, material_spec free-text + optional FK pickers for purchase_orders / document_matl_cert)
4. /production-card/[id]/parts/[partId]/routing — per-part routing editor: pick template → ops added with seq, planner can reorder, add finishing ops, set wps_id for weld ops, mark hold-points

State stays 'draft' throughout. No issue button here — that's pc-007.
Auth: planner role required (use jobcard_project_members or new production_card_project_members).
close_reason: Planner web UI MVP. Pages: / (card list with project-item, doc-number via JOIN, state pill, exc class), /new (project picker by projectnumber → item radio picker → variant), /[cardId] (header dl + parts table + add-part form, delete-draft button), /[cardId]/parts/[partId]/routing (apply-template buttons, op table with up/down reorder, WPS picker for weld ops, hold-point toggle, append-op form, read-only when card is not draft). Server actions for all mutations via service-role admin client (RLS bypassed for now — proper role gate is post-MVP). next build passes.

title: Smart-device (mobile/tablet) web inspection flow
description:
Post-MVP refinement of inspection UX. At MVP, op-level and final inspections happen at the kiosk (Pi + 7" touchscreen). The kiosk may not be physically close to the work area — inspectors should be able to complete inspections from a smart device in hand (phone or tablet).

Scope:
- A /inspect/* set of routes in the same Next.js app, optimised for mobile-portrait layout.
- Auth via auth_users (web sign-in, not RFID).
- Inspector logs in, sees a list of awaiting inspections across cards filtered by their role.
- Same SoD rules (R2, R4) enforced.
- Same production_card_inspection schema (no new tables).

Blocked on: nothing structurally — schema supports this today. Just UI work + auth flow + responsive layout. P3 because kiosk-only is acceptable MVP.

title: Migrate traveller PDF generation to pss-pdf-render service (when available)
description:
MVP renders the full traveller PDF inside production-card using @react-pdf/renderer, isolated behind a single function: generateTravellerPdf(cardData) -> bytes. This issue tracks the eventual migration to the cross-app pss-pdf-render service (per CONTEXT.md term).

Migration shape (when pss-pdf-render exists):
- Replace internal generateTravellerPdf() call with HTTP POST to pss-pdf-render: { template_name: 'production_traveller_v1', data: cardData } -> bytes.
- Same downstream POST /api/file to pss-document-service. No change there.
- Template moves from this repo to pss-pdf-render's template registry; cardData payload stays the same.

Decoupling discipline (in MVP code, must be honoured for the migration to stay cheap):
- One isolated module: app/lib/pdf/generateTravellerPdf.ts
- Single entry point: generateTravellerPdf(cardData: CardPdfData): Promise<Buffer>
- Template logic stays in @react-pdf component files under app/lib/pdf/templates/
- No PDF library imports outside app/lib/pdf/

Blocked on: existence of pss-pdf-render service (separate cross-app project — NOT in this repo's bd backlog).

title: Web: EXC >= 3 structured inspection panel
description:
Extends the lightweight inspection flow (pss-production-card-3wk) for EXC >= 3 cards: defect type from a controlled list, location attached to the seam (per ADR-0002), severity per ISO 5817 levels (B/C/D), required photo upload count, dim record link. Replaces the freeform pass/fail UI with a structured per-defect record when card.exc_class >= 3.

Blocked on the Seam/Pass model becoming live (currently P4 backlog: pss-production-card-boj for the migration, pss-production-card-bf6 for the seam picker).

title: NCR (Non-Conformance Report) system — design + implementation
description:
Build the NCR subsystem. Captures: what's wrong, why (root cause), disposition (use-as-is/rework/repair/scrap/return), corrective + preventive action, signoffs. Integration points already on the radar (per CONTEXT.md NCR entry):

1. production_card_inspection.result='fail' — failed inspection is the natural NCR trigger. The inspection's notes/defects jsonb/level_iso5817/photo_doc_ids fields seed the NCR record.
2. production_card_part_op.state='rework' — NCR documents the why behind the rework cycle.
3. production_card.state='closed' (immutable) — NCR is the only escape hatch per architecture. Likely needs a new state 'under_amendment' for closed cards being re-opened for corrective action.

Likely schema: new production_card_ncr table (FK to card + optional inspection_id + optional op_id), production_card_ncr_signoff for resolution audit. Naming convention locked: card-scoped tables use production_card_ prefix.

Out of scope for MVP. Architecture already says 'Closed = immutable: only an NCR or formal amendment can change records' (ARCHITECTURE.md:99) — this issue makes that real. Will need its own grill before implementation.

title: Weld Map integration spec
description: Lock the contract for the external Weld Map dataset: source (Supabase rows / JSON sidecar / enriched IFC), schema fields per seam (seam_no, joint_type, etc.), join key (drawing/part identity), revision semantics, snapshot extraction at card issue. Gates the EXC>=3 seam picker. Probably needs its own grill before implementation.
notes:
DECISIONS 2026-09-14 (Steve), taken while fixing weld identity in cad-automation-stage3:
- SOURCE: cad-automation-stage3. Its cas_connection table already numbers and ratifies welds, and weld numbers plus review now survive re-detection (bd cad-automation-stage3-5mn, verified on live rows).
- JOIN KEY: the stage3 mark of the weldment prototype in cas_piece_mark (e.g. A00001), allocated per project and part fingerprint and reused across revisions. Caveat: an A-prefix is only allocated when a weldment is exploded; one produced first keeps its class-prefixed mark. production_card_part has no mark column today, so a Part will need to carry it.
- SEAM IDENTITY: per weldment TYPE - A00001-W003 is shared by every copy of the weldment. Physical pieces are already told apart by paint-pen serials (ADR 0003), so seam x serial is the physical weld. Implemented under bd cad-automation-stage3-ry4s.
- TRANSPORT: an IFC-shaped JSON export per assembly, imported into production_card_part_seam at card issue. A snapshot is a copy anyway, and stage3 is not on Supabase yet.
Spec draft to follow in docs/.

title: Planner UI: Seam picker at issue for EXC >= 3
description: Per ADR-0002. At card issue for EXC>=3, planner picks seams from the external Weld Map for each Part. Picked seams snapshot into production_card_part_seam (immutable on issue; new card_rev to re-snapshot). For EXC<=2 the system auto-creates one synthetic seam per Weld Op; planner sees nothing seam-related. Blocked on Weld Map integration spec.

title: Kiosk: retrospective pass declaration at session-stop
description: Per ADR-0002 the welder keys pass-count + root/cap flag at scan-out. EXC>=3 prompts; EXC<=2 silently creates one synthetic pass. First pass on a seam defaults to root, last to cap, middle to fill; welder can override at stop. Skipped declaration (RFID failure / shift auto-close) defaults to 1 pass type=other and flags the seam 'pass-count-unspecified' for QC review.

title: Kiosk: triple-scan flow (operator + plant + part) + session FK to plant
description: Per ADR-0001 the kiosk session binds operator + plant + op together. Update firmware to scan plant QR after operator RFID and before part QR. Reject session-open if plant.state!='available', or plant.plant_type != op.required_plant_type, or operator missing required role. Adds plant_id to production_card_event payload.

title: Planner UI: Plant CRUD admin page
description: Small admin page to register and edit Plant assets — list, add, edit name + plant_type, toggle state to maintenance/retired. Per ADR-0001. Needed so kiosk Plant scan can resolve to a valid plant and planner can take a saw offline for service without manually decrementing a capacity counter.

title: Migration: Seam + Pass tables + inspection.pass_id FK
description: Per ADR-0002 (welding evidence model). Add production_card_part_seam (seam_no, weld_map_source, weld_map_id nullable, state) and production_card_part_seam_pass (seam_id, pass_no, pass_type root/fill/cap/other, session_id, declared_at). Add nullable pass_id FK to production_card_inspection. Storage uniform across EXC classes; EXC<=2 gets a single synthetic seam+pass auto-created.
notes: Weld Map contract (docs/weld-map-contract.md section 5, ADR 0007), 2026-09-14. Proposed snapshot columns beyond seam_no, weld_map_source, weld_map_id and state: status_at_issue, location, length_mm, size_text, wps_no, method. weld_map_source = the export's sha256 plus the stage3 model id. Keep weld_map_id NULLABLE: stage3 emits it null until seam numbers are stable across revisions (stage3 bd cad-automation-stage3-ry4s and -jjlu). Also needed: production_card_part.weld_map_mark text, the join key.

title: Migration: Plant register + op.required_plant_type + part.max_concurrent_plant
description: Per ADR-0001 (plant-centric capacity). Add plant table (id, name, plant_type, state in {available, in_use, maintenance, retired}), add required_plant_type column to production_card_part_op (nullable for hand ops), add max_concurrent_plant int to production_card_part (default 1). RLS to match existing production_card_* policies.

value: 3wk inspection + close model locked 2026-05-17. Op-level inspections at hold-points: kiosk-only for MVP, pass/fail/rework, fail resets op to 'pending' (operator redoes). Failure chain queryable via multiple inspection rows on same card_part_op_id. Final inspection: register-based — production_inspection_type table with 6 seeded codes (geometric, weld_visual, weld_mpi, weld_dpi, cosmetic, client_specific). production_card.required_final_inspections text[] specifies which apply. App rules: geometric always; weld_visual auto when EXC>=2 AND weld op; NDT dropdown (None|MPI|DPI) default None at EXC2; if MPI/DPI chosen, ndt_coverage_percent (1-100) required. One inspection row per type at final. Card -> 'complete' when all required types pass. Close model: 2-actor (closer ≠ any final-inspector via R4 app-layer); no paperwork_signed_by column. PDF: two doc-service identities per card (issued_doc_id at issue, closed_doc_id at close) per ADR-0005, same iso_description_id (66/67), refile_override unused. Smart-device inspection UX deferred to a P3 follow-on.

production_card scopes to exactly ONE project_register_items row. Identity FKs only: production_card.doc_id → document_incoming_scan.id (resolves doc_number via JOIN), production_card.project_register_item_id → project_register_items.id (resolves projectnumber + item_seq via JOIN). Do NOT store doc_number or project_number as text columns on production_card. exc_class is a single column on production_card (denormed from project_register_items at issue time, applies to all parts on the card). production_card_part has NO exc_class and NO project_register_item_id — both inherited from card.

Initial design grilled and locked 2026-05-11. Port 3014, route /production-card/, service production-card. Op resolution at kiosk is IMPLICIT — operator skill + part state picks the next pending op, no menu. Welding pre-flight at weld scan-in is the lever for low-friction EXC2/3 compliance. WPS + welder quals canonical here; consumables stay on monday.com short-term then move to matl-cert. Doc numbering via pss-document-service 61355: M&DC, desc 66 shop / 67 site, shared serial pool per project. Card states: draft → issued (dual signoff planner+qc) → in_progress → awaiting_final → complete → closed (immutable). SoD enforced: same person can't operate+accept same op, can't issue+final-inspect same card.

Kiosk hardware locked 2026-05-16: Raspberry Pi 4 + 7" capacitive touchscreen + USB barcode scanner + USB RFID reader in a wall-mount enclosure. NOT M5Stack (screen too small for the serial picker; splits dev across firmware + web). Kiosk runs the SAME Next.js app as the planner UI, locked to /kiosk route in browser kiosk mode (Chromium --kiosk). Same Docker pipeline, same auth model. No firmware. Drop the firmware/ directory plan from earlier scaffolds. RFID lookup still reuses employee_cards from pss-employee-presence. HMAC-signed POSTs unchanged — wire protocol identical to the firmware plan it replaces. Per ADR-0004.

Subcard model locked 2026-05-16. Card has 1+ subcards = production_card_part rows, one per primary drawing. Subcard identity = (card.doc_number, primary_drawing.doc_number) — no A/B/C suffix. New FK production_card_part.primary_drawing_doc_id -> document_incoming_scan(id), mandatory at issue. Cover sheet displays drawing's title-block number; subcard QR encodes the system doc_number(s). Physical pieces (qty > 1) marked with paint-pen serials (001, 002, ...) per subcard — operator-applied, not pre-allocated. Captured retrospectively at session-stop via touch-grid serial picker; persisted in production_card_event.meta jsonb as {pieces_completed: [{serial, heat?}, ...]}. Welding heat can vary per-piece (consumables change mid-shift). drawing_number/drawing_rev text columns on production_card_part to be dropped. Per ADR-0003.

Cards are immutable from issue (2026-05-16 refinement). card_rev mechanism abandoned — column to be dropped. Replacement = new production_card row with fresh doc_number minted from doc-service; predecessor's superseded_by_card_id points to new card; predecessor state -> 'superseded'. doc-service refile_override unused for cards. Issue gate is all-or-nothing: every subcard must have primary_drawing_doc_id filed in doc-service before issue. No hold-per-line / partial-issue. If a subcard isn't ready, planner removes it and creates a separate new card for it later. Per ADR-0003.

Table naming locked 2026-05-11. Card-scoped: production_card, production_card_part, production_card_part_op, production_card_event, production_card_op_session (view), production_card_inspection, production_card_signoff. Welding registers: welding_wps, welding_welder_qualification. Production registers: production_op_library, production_routing_template, production_routing_template_op. Column adds: employees.skill_set text[], employees.auth_user_id uuid NULL FK, project_register.exc_class smallint. Conventions: snake_case singular; card-scoped prefixed production_card_; welding registers welding_; generic production registers production_; no v_ prefix on views.

EXC class lives on project_register_items.exc_class (per item, not per project — items on a single project can differ). Denormed to production_card_part.exc_class at card issue. Drop any reference to project_register.exc_class or production_card.exc_class — those were earlier drafts. Pre-flight rules and inspection-fidelity (lightweight vs structured EXC3+) apply per part-op using the part's exc_class. Also: employees.skill_set was renamed to employees.role text[] (operator trades — welder/fabricator/painter/fitter/inspector/qc/site).
